chocobo_raising.label: Chocobo Raising
chocobo_raising.summary: Evidence-led DSP compatibility and implementation tracker for raising, caring for, registering, breeding and riding personal chocobos. An upstream file being present is not proof of DSP functionality.
chocobo_raising.compare: Compare authoritative live DSP checkout against pinned LSB reference for Lua logic, SQL schema, event traffic, item exdata and mount representation. Unknown must not be treated as missing.

findings.name: NPC packet sequences
findings.finding: Record DSP packet IDs, option masks, string parameters and retail trace evidence; no claim that all are covered
dsp_evidence: source:src/map/packets/event.cpp:5-60 (0x032/0x034, eight u32 params, ActIndex/EventNum/Mode at LSB-equivalent offsets)
source:src/map/lua/lua_baseentity.cpp:2857-2930 (startEvent: EventID + up to 8 params + optional textTable arg 10; argument-count guard n>10)
source:src/map/lua/lua_baseentity.h:214-216 (startEventString 0x033, updateEvent, updateEventString)
source:src/map/packet_system.cpp:2626-2650 (0x05B: EndPara@0x08, Mode@0x0E, EventPara@0x12; Mode!=0 -> onEventUpdate else onEventFinish; EventID must match m_event)
source:src/map/packet_system.cpp:2631-2634 (m_event.Option overrides the client's EndPara when nonzero)
source:src/map/lua/lua_baseentity.h:274-275 (tradeComplete, confirmTrade), packet_system 0x036 trade path
findings.dsp_note: Source-read only. The generic event start/update/finish, string-event and trade machinery match the field layout of LSB's GP_SERV_COMMAND_EVENTNUM (8 nums) and GP_CLI_COMMAND_EVENTEND, so no new packet classes appear to be required for the trainer menus; this is NOT proof that the chocobo option sequence works. Specific risks: (1) m_event.Option sticky override can swallow option values the VM reads; (2) LSB's event_playout relies on a dedicated Mode=UpdatePending flow and startEventString for naming/debug; DSP has startEventString but the name-entry reply fields were never exercised; (3) retail/capture evidence for the actual trainer sequence is absent in this repo; check <local>/Playthrough Captures for chocobo raising captures first. Per CLAUDE.md, startEvent padding must follow capture evidence per csid.

findings.name: Personal whistle and mount
findings.finding: Check Chocobo License, personal appearance packed flags, registration, inventory and riding support
dsp_evidence: source:scripts/globals/items/chocobo_whistle.lua:6-18 (rental: onItemCheck -> canUseChocobo; onItemUse adds EFFECT_MOUNTED 900/1800 s by level)
source:src/map/lua/lua_baseentity.cpp:4848-4860 (canUseChocobo: key item 138 Chocobo License, zone MISC_CHOCOBO)
source:src/map/zone.cpp:866-871 (mount removed on zone without MISC_CHOCOBO)
source:src/map/entities/battleentity.cpp:198 (mounted speed fixed at 40 + map_config.speed_mod; no per-player speed)
source:src/map/packets/char.cpp:114 (0x34 mount word hard-coded 0x010CA248 for every PC; no custom properties)
source:src/map/packets/zone_in.cpp:151 (hard-coded 0xD4 at 0x5E)
source:scripts/globals/keyitems.lua:144 (CHOCOBO_LICENSE = 138)
findings.dsp_note: Source-read only. Rental mount, License check and zone gating work in source. Personal chocobo is missing entirely: no ChocoboCustomProperties bitfield (beak/talons/tail/color/speed/minutes), no mountutils equivalent, no MOUNTED subPower personal flag (LSB 0x40), no ChocoboIndex 2 packet path, and speed/time are constants. LSB ref: src/map/utils/mountutils.{h,cpp}, packets/char_update.cpp:283-300, char_sync.cpp:55-57, battle_entity.cpp:360, charutils.cpp:2046/3180. The DSP 0x00D layout is the older fixed-offset writer, so the LSB bit layout for the mount fields must be re-derived/captured for this client build (CLIENT_VER 30170905_5) before use. Existing whistle behaviour must be preserved when no registered chocobo exists.
